lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: ACCESS REVOKED — ALLOCATION AUDITOR, ENCLAVE 7 — REVIEW FLAG APPLIED — ORIGINATING DEPARTMENT: —

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: There is no originating department. A flag has to come from somewhere. Every flag in eleven years came from somewhere.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The corridor lights come on in sequence, from the far end, toward you. Nobody has walked down that corridor since six.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Kell. The monastery in the valley. It is the last place in this Enclave system that does not report to anyone.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Go. The door is the only way out and it is about to be the only way in.
